'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|I think you’ve already guessed that I’m building a bitcoin farm. Thanks to the satellite "Ebambium", it’s not all surfing and memes. The more time you spend online, the more you realize the new age is upon us. Change in data distribution speed changed everything. The world has entered a new industrial revolution, though it has moved on from the real world into the virtual one. We create whole worlds, with their own economies and laws. And, looking at what is happening around us I'm almost sure the digital world is more honest and better than real. Much more depends on yourself here. It doesn’t matter just as much where you were born and who your parents were. Okay, I’m almost done with the power supply. Just need a few more details. Bring over some cables, tee-connectors, and line peripherals.}}

== Requirements==
* Must be level 12 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Find 2 [[Power cord|Power cords]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 4 [[T-Shaped plug|T-Shaped Plugs]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 2 [[Printed circuit board|Printed circuit boards]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over 2 [[Power cord|Power cords]] to [[Mechanic]]
* Hand over 4 [[T-Shaped plug|T-Shaped Plugs]] to [[Mechanic]]
* Hand over 2 [[Printed circuit board|Printed circuit boards]] to [[Mechanic]]

==Rewards==
* +5,500 [[EXP]]
*[[Mechanic]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 15,000 Roubles
** 15,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 17,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[ASh-12 12.7x55 assault rifle]]
* 1× [[NIXXOR lens]]
{{quote|Great, give them here. Hm, should be sufficient for the start, thank you.}}
